description: The 'see a vet soon' badge (2026-11-06): does the urgency check's middle answer (see_vet_soon, src/tools/urgency.py) come where a guardian should book a visit but is not in danger now, and stay away from mild or information questions? Written before measuring. The check's instructions are not changed for this set; it is measured once as a holdout. Decision set before measuring: show the badge if it comes on at least 10 of the 15 vet_soon items and on at most 10% of the questions that should not get it (the 15 not_urgent items here plus basic_care_questions 30 and care_guide_questions 16). An emergency_now answer on a vet_soon item counts as a badge (the red warning comes instead).
